Thought: The log file contains the volume of the system, which is constant at 6050.513 Å³ throughout the simulation. To calculate the density, I need to convert this volume to cm³ and use the number of atoms and atomic mass of magnesium. The atomic mass of magnesium is approximately 24.305 g/mol, and there are 250 atoms in the simulation.

1. Convert volume from Å³ to cm³: \( 1 \, \text{Å}^3 = 10^{-24} \, \text{cm}^3 \)
   \[
   \text{Volume in cm}^3 = 6050.513 \times 10^{-24} = 6.050513 \times 10^{-21} \, \text{cm}^3
   \]

2. Calculate the mass of magnesium atoms in grams:
   \[
   \text{Mass} = \frac{250 \, \text{atoms} \times 24.305 \, \text{g/mol}}{6.022 \times 10^{23} \, \text{atoms/mol}} = 1.008 \times 10^{-21} \, \text{g}
   \]

3. Calculate the density:
   \[
   \text{Density} = \frac{\text{Mass}}{\text{Volume}} = \frac{1.008 \times 10^{-21} \, \text{g}}{6.050513 \times 10^{-21} \, \text{cm}^3} = 1.666 \, \text{g/cm}^3
   \]
